title: member-could-be-private lint rule (lane ATLB)
summary: Hint (OFF in 1.52) on a public member used only in its own unit; published, virtual, interface, attributed and shared-unit members stay silent
intro: Read this to see when member-could-be-private reports a public member, which members it never touches, and why component-create-without-override was refused in favour of hides-ancestor-virtual.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint lint-all --rule member-could-be-private --db <db> (default OFF in 1.52; naming it with --rule runs it, category project-wide, hint)
